youtube.title: George Washington returned his enemy's DOG mid-war 🐶 #shorts
youtube.caption:
George Washington lost the battle… then returned the enemy general's dog 🐶

Would YOU have given the dog back? Yes or no 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: after the Battle of Germantown (October 1777), British General William Howe's dog wandered into the American camp. On 6 October 1777 Washington sent it back under a flag of truce with a note: "General Washington's compliments to General Howe" — the collar showed whose dog it was.
